interface.shortDescription: Turn past fixes into faster AI coding
interface.longDescription: Spend less time repeating investigations, retrying failed approaches, or teaching a new agent the same lesson. Learned Experience gives Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and other compatible AI tools a shared library of fixes, pitfalls, and practical lessons that persists across sessions. In Codex, relevant lessons surface automatically when you start a task or a tool fails, and the agent is prompted to capture useful discoveries as it works. Checked successes and failures help rank future recommendations. Your lessons stay in a local database you control, with export and import for moving between machines. No account or API key is required.
defaultPrompt: Recall relevant past fixes for this task and verify any advice before applying it.
